target_customer: Neurologists, hospitals and device makers treating Parkinson's, essential tremor and epilepsy with deep brain stimulation
problem: Current deep brain stimulation electrodes are large and open loop. Torpedo builds micro electrode leads that sense and stimulate, with a chip and machine learning for closed loop control.
business_model: Medical device development, expected product sales or licensing after regulatory approval

founders.name: Ingrid van Welie
education: PhD (per YC page; school not stated)
previous_startups: Neural Dynamics Technologies (relationship to Torpedo unconfirmed)
founders.background_notes: YC page calls her a neuroscientist and biophysicist. NIH RePORTER lists her as principal investigator of an SBIR award to Neural Dynamics Technologies; an MTEC listing groups the two names.

competitors.name: Medtronic (Percept PC with BrainSense)
competitors.what: Implantable DBS pulse generator able to record neural signals from the stimulation lead, a base for closed loop DBS
competitors.traction_then: Percept PC was already on the market with sensing; a 2021 review describes it as a closed loop tool for movement disorders

technical_complexity.rationale: Micro and nano fabricated electrode leads, a custom readout chip and closed loop algorithms for implantable brain devices need years of device engineering and regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: Patents, device know how and FDA approval would be hard to replicate, but none of these is evidenced by sources I found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Medtronic received FDA approval for BrainSense Adaptive DBS on 2025-02-24; no acquisition of Torpedo was found.

market_need_then: DBS is FDA approved for Parkinson's, essential tremor and epilepsy and incumbents were adding sensing, which shows clinical interest in closed loop stimulation.

identity.visual_style: Technical medical device site focused on precision

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press or community found; a separate unrelated C4 Therapeutics platform also uses the word Torpedo.

outcome_analysis: Torpedo Therapeutics is an early stage device company led by a neuroscientist founder, aiming at closed loop deep brain stimulation. Public sources show no priced round, only aggregator mentions of YC money, so its financing and progress are unknown. The path is long and capital heavy, and Medtronic reached closed loop DBS approval in 2025.
notes: Unverified funding: MTEC lists 500K from YC, CB Insights says seed, Extruct says pre-seed; all aggregators. An NIH SBIR R43 of 55,000 dollars (FY2020) went to Neural Dynamics Technologies with van Welie as PI; the link to Torpedo is unconfirmed so it is not a round. Founding year 2018 from CB Insights style profile listing, unverified. Education of van Welie beyond the PhD title not found. Completeness pass: recorded CB Insights' seed (2024-08-28, no amount; investors from VCBacked), Caplight's $500K YC round (2022-01) and a Caplight grant (2025-11-05, no amount); Caplight shows 1.19M total. Dates conflict across databases and no press confirms them.
